releases.notes:
Patina & Chime for **Minecraft 26.2 on Fabric**.

## Install

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) 0.20.1 or newer for Minecraft 26.2. The game needs Java 25.
2. Put [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) 0.161.0 or newer for 26.2 and `patina-and-chime-0.2.0+26.2.jar` (below) in your `mods` folder.

Your client and any server you join both need the mod. This version won't load on 26.3.

## What's new since 0.1.3

### Added

- The shatter note: the top note of an amethyst note block breaks every full-grown crystal on budding amethyst within 8 blocks, for 2 shards each. Each note block can do this once per second, and there's no option to turn it off.

Redstone or a left-click at the top note fires it, and so does a right-click stepping up from the note below. Buds, budding amethyst and clusters on any other block are left alone.

**Server owners:** land-claim mods may not stop this, so a player outside a claim could harvest an amethyst farm inside one, at half yield. The crystals grow back.

## How it was made

I set the direction for this mod. Claude, an AI coding tool, wrote the code and the scripts that draw the art.

## Install

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) 0.20.1 or newer for Minecraft 26.2. The game needs Java 25.
2. Put [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) 0.161.0 or newer for 26.2 and `patina-and-chime-0.1.3+26.2.jar` (below) in your `mods` folder.

Your client and any server you join both need the mod. This version won't load on 26.3.

## What's new since 0.1.0

### Added

- A Block of Amethyst crafts into 4 amethyst shards. Four shards already make a block in vanilla, so it now works both ways.

### Fixed

- Every recipe now unlocks in the recipe book.
- An oxidized hopper's tooltip no longer says it keeps aging.
- An exposed hopper no longer picks up items lying on a chest above it.
- A pull that doesn't fit no longer changes the container above.
- Copper hoppers now move items to and from machines that use Fabric's item storage, and a full pipe testing one no longer stops it.
- Music no longer slows budding amethyst that another mod has sped up, and no longer shows its note particles where it changes nothing.
- The mod now asks for Fabric API 0.161.0 or newer, so the loader names the problem when it's older.
- The enchanting table change no longer relies on a name the compiler generates, so it won't break on a rebuilt game.

releases.notes:
First release of Patina & Chime, for **Minecraft 26.2 on Fabric**.

## Install

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) 0.20.1 or newer for Minecraft 26.2. The game needs Java 25.
2. Put [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) for 26.2 and `patina-and-chime-0.1.0+26.2.jar` (below) in your `mods` folder.

Your client and any server you join both need the mod. This version won't load on 26.3.

## What's in it

- **Copper hoppers:** slower than iron, with a different job at each oxidation stage. Wax one to keep its job.
- **Verdigris:** scrape it off old copper, then use it to age other copper.
- **Tuning fork:** strike it to find budding amethyst within 32 blocks.
- **Amethyst at the enchanting table:** shards cost double what lapis does, and show every enchantment in an offer.
- **Music grows crystals:** a jukebox or note block speeds up budding amethyst nearby.
- **Amethyst note block:** put a note block on a Block of Amethyst.

## Worth a listen

The automated tests can't judge how things sound, so the amethyst note block and the tuning fork haven't been checked by ear yet. If something sounds off, or breaks, please [open an issue](https://github.com/gr8monk3ys/patina-and-chime/issues).
